create_site_sensor: create a SiteSensor instance from a mujoco site element to measure position and velocity
get_site_position: get the world x,y,z position of a mujoco site using the POS observation key
get_site_quaternion: get the world orientation quaternion of a mujoco site using the QUAT observation key
get_site_velocity_world: get the linear and angular world velocity of a mujoco site using VEL_WORLD observation
get_site_velocity_relative: get the local twist velocity of a mujoco site in its own frame using VEL_RELATIVE
